name: employee-file
title: Employee file
for_each: select id, name from v_people where status in ('active','leaving','starting') order by name

sections.title: Employment
sections.sql: select code, employer, job_title, department, manager, employment_type, hours_per_week, start_date, fixed_term_end, trial_period_days, probation_end, work_rights, visa_expires_on, status from v_people where id = $1

sections.title: Agreements
sections.sql: select kind, offered_on, signed_on, starts_on, ends_on, summary from agreements where employee_id = $1 order by coalesce(signed_on, offered_on)

sections.title: Information statements (Australia)
sections.sql: select kind, given_on, evidence from statements where employee_id = $1 order by given_on

sections.title: Leave balances
sections.sql: select leave_type, hours, as_at from leave_balances where employee_id = $1 order by leave_type

sections.title: Reviews
sections.sql: select kind, due_on, completed_on, reviewer, outcome from reviews where employee_id = $1 order by due_on desc

sections.title: Certifications and licences
sections.sql: select certification, issued_on, expires_on, state from v_certs where employee_id = $1

sections.title: Policies acknowledged
sections.sql: select p.name as policy, a.version, a.acknowledged_on from acknowledgements a join policies p on p.id = a.policy_id where a.employee_id = $1 order by p.name

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select rule, finding from v_compliance where item like (select name from v_people where id = $1) || ' (%'

name: manager-pack
title: Manager pack
for_each: select distinct m.id, m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name as name from employees m join employees p on p.manager_id = m.id where p.termination_date is null or p.termination_date >= current_date order by name

sections.title: Your team
sections.sql: select name, job_title, employment_type, start_date, status from v_current where manager_id = $1 order by name

sections.title: Leave to decide
sections.sql: select q.name, q.leave_type, q.starts_on, q.ends_on, q.days_waiting from v_leave_open q join employees e on e.id = q.employee_id where e.manager_id = $1

sections.title: Reviews you owe
sections.sql: select r.name, r.kind, r.due_on, r.state from v_reviews r join employees e on e.id = r.employee_id where e.manager_id = $1 order by r.due_on

sections.title: Trials and probation
sections.sql: select t.name, t.kind, t.ends_on, t.days_left, t.reviewed from v_trials t join employees e on e.id = t.employee_id where e.manager_id = $1

sections.title: Tickets and licences expiring
sections.sql: select c.name, c.certification, c.expires_on, c.state from v_certs c join employees e on e.id = c.employee_id where e.manager_id = $1 and c.state in ('expired','expiring')

name: leave-liability
title: Annual leave liability
for_each: select id, name from employers order by name

sections.title: Annual leave by person
sections.note: Hours from the last payroll import. Value the hours in payroll, which holds the pay rates.
sections.sql: select b.name, b.hours, b.weeks, b.as_at, b.large from v_balances b join employees e on e.id = b.employee_id where e.employer_id = $1 and b.leave_type = 'annual' order by b.hours desc
